errors.dir_not_writable: you cannot write to {dir}, and this installer does not use sudo. Choose a directory you own, e.g. OCTOPUS_INSTALL_DIR=$HOME/.local/bin
errors.mirror_needs_version: OCTOPUS_RELEASE_BASE_URL needs OCTOPUS_VERSION (the mirror cannot answer "latest")
errors.no_asset: release {tag} has no asset named {asset} (or the download failed)
errors.no_checksum_entry: {sums} has no entry for {asset}; refusing to install
errors.no_release_id: the release payload from {repo} carried no id
errors.no_releases:
cannot find a release in {repo}: none is published yet, or the repository is private.
For a private repository set GITHUB_TOKEN (for example GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token)).
errors.no_sha_tool: no sha256sum or shasum on this machine, so the checksum cannot be checked
errors.no_tag_name: the release payload from {repo} carried no tag_name
errors.required: {tool} is required and was not found on PATH
errors.signature_failed: signature check failed for {sums}: it was not signed by {repo}'s release workflow; refusing to install
errors.signature_required: OCTOPUS_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=1 but cosign is not installed
errors.unsupported_arch: unsupported architecture {arch}: releases are built for amd64 and arm64
errors.unsupported_os: unsupported OS {os}: releases are built for linux and darwin
errors.unverified_refused: {reason}; refusing to install (set OCTOPUS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY=1 to install unverified)
errors.write_failed: cannot write {path} (set OCTOPUS_INSTALL_DIR to a directory you own)

cli.signature_ok: signature ok ({sums} signed by {repo}'s release workflow)
cli.no_cosign: ! cosign not found: only the checksum is verified, not who published the release (install cosign to check the signature)
cli.next_steps:
Next, configure and start Thulu (outside a checkout it writes the deployment files to ~/.octopus):
  {command}
cli.usage:
Installs the thulu CLI from a GitHub release.

  curl -fsSL {url} | sh
  curl -fsSL {url} | sh -s -- --version 1.0.0

Options:
  --version VERSION  install that release instead of the latest (same as OCTOPUS_VERSION)
  -h, --help         show this help

Environment:
  OCTOPUS_INSTALL_DIR=DIR         where the binary goes (default: a writable directory on PATH, else ~/.local/bin)
  OCTOPUS_NO_INIT=1               do not offer to run `thulu init` at the end
  GITHUB_TOKEN=TOKEN              only for a private repository (otherwise downloads come from github.com)
  OCTOPUS_RELEASE_BASE_URL=URL    download from a mirror laid out as <URL>/v<version>/<asset>
  OCTOPUS_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=1     fail when cosign is not installed
  OCTOPUS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY=1  install when a check cannot run (never when one fails)
cli.already_installed: {tag} is already installed at {path}; nothing to do
cli.shadowed: ! {other} comes before {path} on your PATH, so `thulu` runs that one. Remove it, or run {path}
